measuringSessionReading.grounds: Four admin-panel queries, including the one that returns grouped environment variables, were guarded by ImpersonateGuard (canImpersonate) rather than by admin-panel access, so a user allowed to impersonate but not to use the admin panel could read them; the fix guards all four with a new AdminPanelGuard requiring canAccessFullAdminPanel. Grounds are moderate: the parent had a guard, the wrong one, and the commit subject reads as feature work.

secondReader.sentence: Admin-panel queries exposing environment variables, system health and queue metrics were gated only by ImpersonateGuard (canImpersonate), not by an admin-panel authorization check; the commit swaps in a new AdminPanelGuard requiring canAccessFullAdminPanel.
secondReader.answerLinesHint: -  @UseGuards(WorkspaceAuthGuard, UserAuthGuard, ImpersonateGuard) / +  @UseGuards(WorkspaceAuthGuard, UserAuthGuard, AdminPanelGuard) on getEnvironmentVariablesGrouped; +return request.user.canAccessFullAdminPanel === true;
